name: How should I prepare my space before wall tile installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my space before wall tile installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your installer arrives, clear all countertops or adjacent floors and remove loose items from the room. Decide on your tile pattern, grout color, and edge trim style, such as bullnose or metal profiles. If the tiling is part of a larger kitchen or bathroom remodel, ensure any underlying plumbing rough-ins, valve replacements, or electrical outlet relocations are scheduled or discussed in advance. Also, check that you have purchased 10 to 15 percent extra tile to account for cuts, waste, and future repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the surrounding area, confirm your tile pattern and grout choices, purchase 10 to 15 percent extra material, and ensure rough plumbing and electrical work are finished.
